name: The Witches of Luminoire
source:
Accepted to the all-girls school of magic, Luminoire Academy, you have one week to prepare for the Full Moon Banquet with one of three charming witches.

[From [url=https://am000zing.itch.io/the-witches-of-luminoire]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
被女子魔法学校Luminoire Academy录取后，你有一周的时间准备与三位迷人女巫之一一起参加满月宴会。

[来自[url=https://am000zing.itch.io/the-witches-of-luminoire]itch.io[/url]]
